presets.name: Classic Starter
presets.description: Four colors, familiar basic heroes, straightforward combat and spell play.

presets.name: Green Assault
presets.description: Drow and Lycan strengthen your board. Savage Wolves grow after combat; Thunderhide Pack breaks towers.

presets.name: Blue / Black Control
presets.description: Zeus and Phantom Assassin threaten heroes. Use cross-lane damage, removal and board clears to control combat.

presets.name: Red / Green Alliance
presets.description: Sven and Pugna lead Mazzie's improvements, Viper's poison and Chen's converts; creeps that grow after combat back them up.

presets.name: Red / Blue Retaliation
presets.description: Timbersaw, Ursa and Centaur Warrunner strip armor and punish attackers; Zeus and J'Muy add burn, card draw and redirection.

presets.name: Red / Black Champions
presets.description: Legion Commander duels, Bristleback and Tidehunter hold the lane, Beastmaster's beasts weaken blockers and Phantom Assassin finishes heroes.

presets.name: Green / Blue Fortress
presets.description: Treant Protector, Enchantress and Dark Seer armor, heal and reposition the board; Zeus and J'Muy control it with spells.

presets.name: Green / Black Conquest
presets.description: Magnus, Abaddon and Omniknight empower, shield and heal; Debbi and Phantom Assassin remove the heroes in their way.

presets.name: Blue Eclipse
presets.description: Luna charges Eclipses while Crystal Maiden and Ogre Magi refill mana and copy spells; J'Muy and Zeus add card draw and burn.

presets.name: Blue / Black Ambush
presets.description: Earthshaker and Outworld Devourer stun and imprison while Prellex's Barracks flood the lanes; Phantom Assassin and Debbi pick off heroes.

presets.name: Blue / Red Swarm
presets.description: Venomancer's Plague Wards, Meepo's clones and Call the Reserves crowd the lanes; Skywrath Mage, Centaur Warrunner and Ursa finish what is left.

presets.name: Black Hunt
presets.description: Winter Wyvern, Bloodseeker and Storm Spirit move, curse and pick their battles; Phantom Assassin and Debbi finish the heroes they catch.

presets.name: Black / Red Siege
presets.description: Sorla Khan and Bounty Hunter bring Assault Ladders, catapults and gold-hungry creeps against the towers; Sven, Keefe and Axe fight in front.

presets.name: Black / Blue Sharpshooters
presets.description: Tinker, Lion and Sniper shoot down units with their abilities while March of the Machines and Necrophos wear the lane down; Zeus strikes every enemy hero.

presets.name: Red Armory
presets.description: Keefe, Axe, Timbersaw, Legion Commander and Bristleback duel and battle up front, armed with Stonehall gear that grows after every combat and Wingfall Hammer's regeneration.

presets.name: Green Bulwark
presets.description: Farvhan, Drow Ranger, Treant Protector, Lycan and Abaddon hold the line behind shields and Vesture of the Tyrant, while Book of the Dead raises the fallen creeps.

presets.name: Blue Arsenal
presets.description: J'Muy, Earthshaker, Prellex, Ogre Magi and Crystal Maiden blink, swap and steal creeps with Blink Dagger, Phase Boots and Helm of the Dominator, while Claszureme Hourglass locks the opponent's draws.

presets.name: Black Bounty
presets.description: Debbi, Phantom Assassin, Bounty Hunter, Necrophos and Lion hunt heroes for gold with Poaching Knife, Revtel Signet Ring and Apotheosis Blade, then spend it in the shop.

presets.name: Blue / Black Siege Works
presets.description: Ogre Magi and Debbi wear the towers down with Ignite, Trebuchets, Unsupervised Artillery and a Steam Cannon while Bitter Enemies counts down; Bounty Hunter, Luna and Prellex's Barracks hold the lanes.

presets.name: Red / Green Fortifications
presets.description: Keefe, Mazzie and Rix fight behind Burning Oil and Steel Reinforcement under Grand Melee; Treant Protector and Chen heal while Unearthed Secrets, Path of the Dreamer and Homefield Advantage hold the towers.

presets.name: Black / Blue Tyranny
presets.description: Bloodseeker, Phantom Assassin and Winter Wyvern fight under The Oath and Assured Destruction while The Tyler Estate starves both towers; J'Muy redirects, Debbi finishes off heroes, and Iron Fog Goldmine and Revtel Investments fill the purse.

presets.name: Blue / Green Bastion
presets.description: Earthshaker and Crystal Maiden stun and freeze what Glyph of Confusion and Conflagration let through; Farvhan, Lycan and Abaddon shield and grow the board with Mist of Avernus, Cheating Death and Selemene's Favor.
